item.name: List all contacts for an organization

request.name: List all contacts for an organization

description.content:
List all contacts for an organization, with optional filtering and pagination.

You can filter contacts by:
  - Search terms (searches names and phone numbers)
  - Group membership
  - Full phone number
  - Local phone number + Country
  - Custom conditions
  - Subscription status
  - No-autodelete setting
  - WhatsApp Business User ID set


Use the `subscriptionstatus` parameter to include subscription status information for a specific campaign. Use the `subscriptionfilter` parameter to filter by subscription status.

query.description: The requested number of items on a page.
Search term to filter contacts by name or phone number
Filter by international phone number (E164, with optional leading +). If "region" is given this should be a local phone number.
Used together with phonenumber, this is the country 2 letter name.
Filter by contacts which have WhatsApp Business User ID set
JSON string of custom conditions for filtering see schema_condition.yaml
Campaign ID to include subscription status information
Filter by subscription status (requires subscriptionstatus parameter)

item.name: Create a new contact in the system

request.name: Create a new contact in the system

description.content:
Add a new contact to the system. This will return a contact ID which can be used in other engageSPARK APIs.

Most APIs will create a contact on the fly when you use a new phone number, but creating it explicitly gives you more control over the contact fields (such as "first name").

Exactly one of "fullPhoneNumber", or "phoneNumber" with "phoneNumberCountry" needs to be set.

Using this API you can create multiple different contacts with the same phone number.

description.content:
API documentation for [engageSPARK](https://www.engagespark.com/).

To use this API you need an "Access token", which can be retrieved from your [User profile](https://app.engagespark.com/profile/api-tokens). In the API calls you need to set the header "Authorization" with the value "Token" followed by your token. For example: "Authorization: Token aaa111bbb222ccc333", NOT "Authorization: aaa111bbb222ccc333".

Please see the [documentation for other integration methods](https://www.engagespark.com/support/how-can-i-use-your-api/) such as inbound SMS rules, Zapier zaps, or Make API Request actions.
